hints.title: Minimum Value Constraint
hints.text: Every 0 must be replaced by an integer at least 1, so the minimum possible sum for each array is the sum of non-zeros plus the count of zeros.

hints.title: Zero Flexibility
hints.text: If an array contains at least one zero, its sum can be increased to any strictly larger integer.

hints.title: Strict Equality Feasibility
hints.text: If one array has a strictly smaller minimum sum and no zeros, it can never reach the larger sum, making equality impossible.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass computing sums and zero counts for both arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all replacement combinations is unbounded and unnecessary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify lower bound constraint and check zero degree of freedom.
